clauses: Bleeding is a HARMFUL condition
figure may discard it by spending the surge specified on the Bleeding condition card

clauses: figure with Bleeding that has resolved an action suffers 1 damage

clauses: Bleeding is not voluntarily suffering strain

clauses: Blast is applied after attack resolves
Blast does not affect the target of the attack

clauses: Blast damage affects both hostile and friendly figures in skirmish

clauses: Damage suffered by Blast is not prevented by block

clauses: If attack inflicts condition (Stunned/Bleeding), condition applied only to target, not to Blast-affected figures
